segments.text: Now Shūsūtras will be explained here.
Tattra-pratmāṁ nareśar-bedavādipādipakṣeṇa-chaita-yeparamārthata-sivyev-vistasi-atma-yid-adheshiti.
First, at first, he exposes here that the reality of universe is self.
It is not false.
The reality of universe is real self.
And it is contrary to the sayings and theory of those who explain and define that nareśar-bedavādipādipādipādipādipakṣeṇa-chaita-yeparamārthata-sivyev-vistasi-atma-yid-adheshiti.
Individual is always individual and universal being is always universal being.
Universal being will never be united with individual being.
On the contrary, he says, individual being is one with universal being.
So, the reality of this whole universe is God consciousness.
It is filled with God consciousness.
And Shūtra is chaitanya-mātmāma.
The supreme consciousness is the reality of everything.
Chaitanya-mātmā means the reality of everything.
Supreme consciousness is the reality of everything.
Because you have come in, come in dreamer.
You have a chaititā-sya-kāśyāpi-sattābhava.
The one who is not, who has not come in consciousness is not existing at all.
A chaititā-sya-kāśyāpi-sattābhava.
Chaititā-kāya-sara-sama-yūrupa.
So, the act of consciousness is same in conscious and unconscious.
The one who is conscious, act of consciousness is there.
The one who is not conscious of that, the act of consciousness is there in the background.
So, the conscious being is that, who makes others conscious.
And Sarvajāna Kriya-satantra, who is independent in each and every knowledge and each and every action.
This state is called chaitanya.
Complete independence.
Sarvajāna Kriya-sambandamāya.
Who is the uniting agency, uniting agency of all knowledges and of all actions.
All knowledges and all actions are united in one consciousness,
and that is complete independence of God-consciousness.
And that complete independence of God-consciousness is possessed by parmashiva only.
Anāsitānaṁ tānaṁ tāṁ parṁ dantarva-titta.
Up to Anāsitāya from earth to Anāsitā Shiva,
all beings are dependent to that conscious being of Shiva.
Although that complete independent state of Shiva is possessed by many aspects of being eternal,
are being all-pervading, are being all-full, purnatha, are being all-knowing.
But all these other aspects of Lord Shiva are found and could be found in other beings also.
So, the one and the only aspect of Lord Shiva is complete independence, Sarvajāna.
Anāsambandamāya.
And that complete independence is found nowhere, except in Lord Shiva, the state of Lord Shiva.
So, the complete independence, the state of complete independence is shown here with full effort.
So, Yitham dharmāntar pratyakhe patāścya.
Chaitanya meti bāva pratyāna darsitām.
So, chaitanya, the word chaitanya, not the word chaitanya.
If he would explain that there are other aspects also existing in the state of Lord Shiva,
other aspects, then he is the aspect of complete independence, Sarthandra.
There are other aspects, all-pervadingness, all-fullness, all-ananda, and so on.
But as there is only one aspect, one aspect and that is Sarthandra.
So, that Sarthandra is being exposed by the word chaitanya.
So, chaitanya is not put in sutras.
Instead of chaitanya, he has put in sutras chaitanya, bāva pratyā.
This shows chaitanya means the independent way of consciousness,
independent state of consciousness.
And that is self.
That is self of everything whatever exists in this world.
Because whatever exists in this world is state of Lord Shiva.
So, Lord Shiva is found everywhere.
Nāpunaranyakopī, bēdavādī, abhivgat, goto, bhinna-bhinna-sabhāva.
And that bhinna-bhinna-sabhāva, the different aspects of Lord Shiva do not exist at all.
You, those different aspects also would exist.
That different aspects of Lord Shiva if, for the time being, we would accept.
How could those different aspects exist?
That differentiated aspects of Lord Shiva if, for the time being, we would accept.
How could those different aspects exist?
He explains the way to exclude them from the aspects of Lord Shiva.
If, those aspects are not filled with satanthriya, then they are zada, then they are unconscious.
Just like anathma.
If, those aspects too are also filled with independent consciousness of Lord Shiva,
then why not accept independent consciousness?
Why to accept those aspects at all?
And at the same time, if this state of God-consciousness is existing in its fullness of independence,
Deśikāla-yākāra-yidivitre-yākāt, time, space and forms.
Also, if they are separate from independent state of consciousness, they are not existing.
Nor is time existing, nor is space existing, nor is form existing.
Caitanya Mahārata-yānuthu-chīdāṭmāpi, if they accept, we accept those aspects also,
that he is nitya, he is akāla-kālita, he is vishyākāra,
Caitanya Mahārata-yānuthu-chīdāṭmāpi, if they are accepted as independent,
then they are filled with consciousness.
If there is not independence in those, then they are away.
They have been carried away from that God-consciousness.
So, they are not existing at all in the state of Lord Shiva.
Caitanya Mahārata-yākāra-yākāra-yākāra-yāt, now take the theory of individual beings.
If all individual beings, totality of individual beings, are all filled with consciousness,
where is the difference between each and every being?
So, the all individual beings are one universal being.
Savavad-yādhāsa-agatana.
Vakṣa-māna-yīdhya, eva-terrekta-māla-sambandu-yoga-yena-bi-yādhāsa-anupati.
Now, take the theory of māla, wheels, ignorance.
Why are that ignorance is existing?
How can that ignorance exist?
If that ignorance is away from God-consciousness, it is not existing at all.
So, where is the ignorance?
If that ignorance is filled with independent state of God-consciousness, then that is not ignorance at all.
That is filled with fullness of God-consciousness.
So, ignorance also is not there.
What is there then?
There is only independent, supreme God-consciousness.
That is the reality of self.
Now, for the time being, we will say, prākh-māla-sī-sate-bhi-mūkh-te-da-shayam-tat-upakṣa-māna-yāt,
nā-nā-atm-vāda-siv-vaktam-aśe-kya-tāyat.
If that veil, that ignorance was existing before you got realized, before you were realized,
this ignorance was existing, beforehand.
Afterwards, it did not exist.
When you were realized, it did not exist.
Nā-nā-atm-vāda-siv-vaktam-aśe-kya-tāyat.
After realization, it did not exist.
It was not true that it was not existing at all, because he finds at that the time of realization
he finds and he knows that it was not existing at all.
So, that ignorance, it was not existing ever.
He termed as ignorance, it existed, but it was not actually ignorance.
It was just non-fullness in knowledge.
Now you will speak of those aspirants who are on the way, on the path, meditating,
meditating, and meditating, and meditating whole day and night, and achieving nothing.
Those are also good and the same, just like ignorant people, that is not the real state of Shiva.
So, the real state of Shiva is full realization.
Then full realization takes place, that is the fullness, that is the fullness,
and that is the reality, and that is the independent way of God-consciousness.
Till then, nothing has happened.
You are as good as Mahamudu.
Although you are meditating day and night, you are as good as Mahamudu or that Kaidara or someone else.
Mahamudu Shiva is as good as Mahamudu.
Those are as good as Mahamudu.
The only reality of Self is Chaidanya.
When you are filled with independent state of Supreme God-consciousness, that is the reality.
And till then, everything is useless.
Everything is nothing.
It is non-Athma, that is Anupati Sujata.
So, there are not individual states of being.
There is only universal state of being, and that is one. That is only one.
It is why, in the very first Shloka, he has explained that God-consciousness is one in many.
Athichara, now we will explain this Sutra in another way.
When a master teaches his disciples, and asks his disciples,
who is the Self?
Atma-kya.
Yati-jigya-sun-ubhade-eshaan-prithi-bhav-yutum.
And the disciple explains, body is not Self.
Breath is not Self. Intellect is not Self.
Wildness is not Self.
And this universe is not Self.
And the tradition of atheists is not Self.
The tradition of Vedas is not Self.
The tradition of Buddhists is not Self.
And Madhivnika is some other school of Buddhism.
Then what is Self?
In the pendant, Supreme God-consciousness is Self and nothing else.
Taseva-shirira, the Kalpitha-pramadripad-e-pi, akalpitha-aham-yumarsama,
is set-pramadrip-tenas-pranad.
And that independent state of God-consciousness is found in Kalpitha-pramadrip-pada also,
in individual states of Shirira, prana, buddhi, and shrinya also.
In Shirira, he is abhav-shirira.
In body, he is abhav-body.
In prana, he is abhav-prana.
In intellect, he is super-intellect.
In awareness, he is full.
In nothingness, he is everything.
So it is akalpitha-aham-yumarsama, is set-pramadrip-tenas-pranad.
And it is the reality of universal eye.
Madhivnika-battarak also says the same, exposition of Self.
Paramatma-suru-pam-tu-sarva-padi-vyavarjitam, chaita-yam-mathman-u-rupam-sarva-shastra-isupati-te.
This independent, supreme state of God-consciousness is the surupa of Self,
which is found in every Shastra.
And that is the reality of Paramatma.
And that is beyond the upadi means, coverings, beyond all coverings.
It is not covered by, it is exposed, fully exposed.
Vigyana-bhara also says the same way.
Chit-dharma-sarva-de-he-shu-vise-shu-nastic-kutr-chit-atachitan-mayam-sarva-bhavyan-bhavujit-jana.
In each and every body, in each and every being,
you find independent state of God-consciousness.
You must find independent state of God-consciousness in each and every body,
in each and every being, in living body.
So, why not concentrate on this totality of individuality,
the state of universal consciousness?
If it is done, bhavujit-jana, one conquers the differentiated state of world.
He is carried about the individual, individuality of consciousness.
This is exposed, this same thing is exposed in these two shlokas of spandha,
by Vasugupthya, Yatakarna-Varvoyam, take the class of organs,
this class of organs of cognition and organs of actions.
Also, you find in them supreme independent state of God-consciousness.
If you go deep and meditate on these organs, the action of organs,
another way of exposition of this sutra is kymchya.
Yadidha-chaitanya-mukhtam-seva-atma.
This chaitanya, this supreme independent state of God-consciousness is the form.
Yatma means form, is the form.
Visheshachodhana, but he has not exposed here whose form?
This supreme independent state of God-consciousness is form.
If it is not said whose form?
You must conclude that this is the form of everything.
This independent supreme state of God-consciousness is the form of everything.
Is the form of nose, is the form of eye, is the form of face,
is the form of arm, is the form of limbs, is the form of sheet,
is the form of everything in this world.
So, bhava-bhava-rupa is Visheshachodhana.
Not only the form of existing world, not existent world also.
Not existent world, you find the milk of bird.
Have you seen?
But the milk of bird is also existing in that supreme independent state of God-consciousness.
Because it is thought over.
You can think of milk of bird.
Anything that can be thought, that is existing.
Although it is non-existent, but it is existing in supreme independent state of God-consciousness.
This surupa, this formation, will never take place of that bird of milk unless it did not exist in consciousness.
It existed in consciousness, so it is thought over.
Baron woman, the son of Baron woman, is existing in supreme independent state of God-consciousness.
Or the daughter of Baron woman.
Non-existent, the thing is, he concludes that non-existent things are so existing in that God-consciousness.
Because of our thinking.
That thinking takes place in our intellect and that intellect is existing in our consciousness.
And that individual consciousness is existing in supreme state of God-consciousness.
So everything is existing.
Whatever you think, whatever you do not think.
Unless there are not novers of objects.
How can these objects exist?
These objects exist only because of the novers of the objects.
So, nover and the known is one.
Nover and the known is one.
So there is nothing right?
Nothing wrong.
Nothing is wrong.
Everything is filled with God-consciousness.
Whatever you do is divine.
Whatever you do not do is divine.
Whatever you commit is divine.
Whatever you do not commit is divine.
Yes, ma.
Sarumayoga.
This supreme...
This individual being is filled with universal, universal state of being.
Sarumayoga.
Yata-caitanya-vistrasiva-savava-tatiya-vita-sadana-ya-pramana-adivara-kam-anupyuktam.
Because this independent, supreme state of God-consciousness
is the formation of the universe.
So, how can you pick up some means out of universe for realisation?
If you pick up some means from universe, but that means to is the meant.
That means whatever you pick up, say Pranayama, Dharana, Dhan and Samadhi etc.,
whatever means you pick up from this universe, that is filled with God-consciousness.
That is not mean, that is in reality meant.
There you are.
That is the end.
There is no picking.
No going.
No sada-na.
Tashapi-supra-kashi-chaitanya-deenasi-datta.
If for the time being you say that these things are not filled with God-consciousness,
even then, they are dependent to that supreme state of God-consciousness.
They cannot be known.
They cannot exist except unless they are found and realised in supreme universal state of God-consciousness.
This supreme state of God-consciousness can never be covered by any other agency.
Because that agency too cannot exist without this supreme God-consciousness.
The agency that would cover this state of God-consciousness.
Do you understand?
This is also said in the heart of Trikha.
Sopada-sasara-chayam-yatvatha-langi-tungi-ya-te-pada-de-se-sharona-se-yatata-te-ya-mbinda-vicala.
You must know the state of independent supreme God-consciousness is in the same way existing
as the chaya shade of your head.
It is existing although you try to cross it and overcome it by your footsteps.
You will never cover that shade, shadow of your head.
So that in the same way that supreme state of God-consciousness can never be realised by other agency.
Only it can be realised by the agency which is filled with God-consciousness.
So there is no need to realise anything.
It is already realised.
The one who tries to cover that shadow of your head.
Tasi-yatata-pada-de-se-sharona-se-yatata-ya-m-itata-darsambandha.
To him, just like at this place of foot, footstep, that shadow never comes.
In the same way that supreme state of independent God-consciousness never comes in objective state.
It is never objective.
It is never found.
It is never realised.
It is the state of realiser.
In Spanda also, it is exposed in these shlokas.
Yatras-thetam-yatam-sarvam-tadas-ti-param-arthata.
In which state this whole universe is existing, that is in real sense the reality of being.
Hence, it is concluded that Shankaratma-sbandh-tattam-chaita-yam-sarvada-soprakasham-param-arth-satasi-yat-param-arthata.
So, it is found that the reality of the supreme movement of Shankara's consciousness, moving.
It is in the state of movement.
It is not fixed.
It is not situated at one place.
It is situated everywhere.
Wherever there is space, it is situated there.
Wherever there is not space, it is situated there.
In space and beyond that, first sutra is over.
Now next sutra.
